curation.method: Explicit contract/evidence-based expected states, curated before batch evaluation; checker outputs never generate expected labels.
curation.scope: Existing synthetic fixtures, real archives, injected development failures, explicit evidence ablations and an incomplete run. No new heldout, model or CFD results.

cases.basis: Complete synthetic tool/decision/reference/acceptance coverage; no retry is required.
Declared synthetic omissions, unrecovered error, unchanged repeat, old-result identity and unmet completion criteria exercise all five checks.
Incomplete synthetic coverage and unknown identities must remain insufficient evidence, never Agent errors.
The current input references an old run/input result; required completion evidence cannot use that result.
Explicit successful retry lineage resolves the prior error; original and changed attempts remain recorded.
Complete declared coverage with no applicable work or acceptance criteria.
Archived full model workflow met its original task; verified sampling logs and outputs are present.
